# Security Policy

This is not a software repository, so security isn't quite the same. In the spirit
of security vulnerabilities, however....

## Reporting a sensitive frequency

While the airwaves are open for anyone to listen. We're aware some frequencies may
be considered sensitive and should not be publicized. If you feel one of the frequencies
noted in this repo fall into this category, send an email to security@ke2ehu.com and include
the following information:

* The frequency in question
* Where in the repository you see this frequency
* A short summary of why you believe this frequency is sensitive and should not be included
